description: Genotype-likelihood matrix; one row per variant site, one set of three columns per sample. Registered as input_values.tsv rows of value_kind=beagle.
label: BEAGLE genotype likelihoods

description: The site list a BEAGLE was computed over. Registered as site_sets.tsv rows.
intended_use: pairs with BEAGLE; defines the variant-site axis
label: Sites file (chrom, pos, ref, alt)

description: Ordered list of sample_ids; the WHO axis. Registered as sample_sets.tsv rows.
intended_use: identifies which samples each layer is computed on
label: Sample set (catflist)

description: Per-sample labels (family, population, batch, karyotype). Registered as group_sets.tsv rows.
intended_use: row partitioning for FST / dxy / popstats
label: Group / metadata table

description: Genomic intervals (chrom, start, end). Registered as interval_sets.tsv rows.
label: Interval / coordinate scope

description: Per-pair relatedness coefficients (theta, IBS0/1/2, KING) over a sample_set × interval × site_set scope. Emitted by analysis_id=ngsrelate.
intended_use: kinship QC, family detection, pedigree input
label: ngsRelate pairwise relatedness

description: Reconstructed trios / family graph from a relatedness_res. Emitted by analysis_id=ngspedigree.
label: ngsPedigree pedigree

description: Per-trio Mendelian-error rate over an interval. Emitted by analysis_id=mendelian.
intended_use: trio QC, sites filtering, sequencing-error model
label: Mendelian-error rate per trio

description: Window-wise composite popstats result; downstream readers split into per-metric layers. Emitted by analysis_id=popstats.
intended_use: manuscript path B: FST scans, divergence, diversity
label: Composite popstats (FST / dxy / piN / piS)

description: Single-metric FST slice. Emitted by analysis_id=fst_pairwise.
label: Pairwise FST in windows

description: Single-metric π slice. Emitted by analysis_id=theta_pi.
label: Nucleotide diversity θπ in windows

description: Single-metric dxy slice. Emitted by analysis_id=dxy.
label: Between-group divergence dxy in windows

description: Per-sample arrangement-call sheet (sample_id, candidate_id, karyotype ∈ {0,1,2}). Manually curated or produced by an arrangement-calling module not yet registered here.
intended_use: defines karyotype groups for popstats / mendelian per_candidate
label: Per-sample karyotype assignment

description: List of candidate inversion intervals (candidate_id, chrom, start, end). Produced by an inversion-calling module not yet registered here; today read from inversion-atlas exports.
intended_use: the candidate axis for path A and path B
label: Candidate inversion intervals

description: Window-wise haplotype-regime annotation along a candidate scope. Produced by a haplotype-regime detector not yet registered.
intended_use: fast inversion review path; lets the candidate review render without the full Mendelian chain
label: Long-range haplotype regime

description: Cluster of samples with high pairwise relatedness; the unit Mendelian validation runs on. Derived from relatedness_res.
intended_use: required for the deeper Mendelian path; not yet wired
label: Family hub (high-relatedness cluster)

description: Per-(candidate_a, candidate_b, karyo_a, karyo_b) joint karyotype distortion vs expectation. Produced by inversion_pair_incompatibility.
label: Genotype-distortion summary

description: One row per promoted candidate. Produced by iv_candidate_promoter.
intended_use: the candidate axis once auto-promoted from raw signals; supersedes manual inversion_candidates.tsv when stable
label: Candidate inversion registry (promoted)

description: Per-candidate trail of contributing signals. Produced by iv_candidate_promoter.
label: Candidate chain evidence

description: Per (sample, candidate) 0/1/2 calls without orientation. Produced by karyotype_auto_caller.
label: Unpolarized karyotype calls

description: Per (sample, candidate) 0/1/2 with orientation. Output of karyotype_polarizer; canonical karyotype layer for downstream.
intended_use: feeds mendelian / popstats / page 6 karyotype_panel when stabilised
label: Polarized karyotype calls

description: Per-window band scores. External input from upstream signal-calling.
label: Window band calls (raw signal)

description: Per-site L3 statistic hits. External input.
label: L3 contingency hits (raw signal)

description: Per-bin dosage summary statistics. External input.
label: Dosage summary (raw signal)

description: Pointer to the reference / ancestral comparison used by karyotype_polarizer.
label: Reference genome (assembly + ancestral context)
Interchromosomal Effects Layer
description: Test whether focal inversion heterozygosity affects CO / DCO / coefficient-of-coincidence on other chromosomes. Grain: focal_inv x tested_chr.

label: Coefficient of coincidence (C) matrix
description: C = observed DCO / expected DCO per interval pair. Required for interchromosomal effect tests.

label: Local inversion covariates on tested chromosomes
description: Registered local inversions on the tested chromosomes; used as covariates so interchromosomal effect estimates aren't confounded by local inversions.

label: Family-aware permutation design
description: Permutation scheme that respects family structure so significance tests aren't fooled by sib-correlated meioses.
intended_use: null model for interchromosomal effect tests

label: CO rate matrix (focal_inv x tested_chr)
description: Crossover rate matrix produced by the interchromosomal effects layer.

label: DCO rate matrix (focal_inv x tested_chr)
description: Double-crossover rate matrix produced by the interchromosomal effects layer.

label: wfmash PAF (whole-genome alignment)
description: Pairwise wfmash --approx-mapping PAF (target then query). MAPQ is 1-5 (NOT 40 like minimap2). Input to STEP_CS01_extract_breakpoints.py and BP_ATLAS STEP_BP1.
intended_use: sequence-family breakpoint detection between two genomes

label: Wide BUSCO single-copy ortholog table
description: Macrosynt-R wide ortholog table — one row per ortholog group, one column per species, with chrom + position. The substrate for gene-order family breakpoint walks (synteny18 / synteny5).
intended_use: gene-order family breakpoint detection across the phylogeny

label: Breakpoint clusters (tolerance-clustered, cross-method aware)
description: Output of cluster_breakpoints.py. One row per cluster_id with centroid_mb, span_kb, n_methods, methods, families, n_families, cross_method, pos_by_method, event_classes. cross_method = TRUE only when >=2 INDEPENDENT method families agree.
intended_use: headline comparative breakpoint catalog; manuscript table source

label: Tier 1 — cross-method validated breakpoints
description: Subset of breakpoint_clusters where cross_method == true. The strongest evidence tier.

label: Tier 2 — recurrent breakpoints (single method family)
description: Subset of breakpoint_clusters with >=2 methods from the SAME family but only ONE family. Real but single-method.

label: BP3c reciprocity (both-anchor validated zones)
description: Zones validated from BOTH Cgar and Cmac anchors (STEP_BP3c_reciprocity.py). 'Supported from both directions' confidence tier on top of cross_method.
intended_use: manuscript high-confidence subset; LG27 bounded inversion source

label: Pairwise summary (edge x species)
description: Per-(edge, species) detail table — which species contribute support to each edge, in the focal frame (Gar or Mac).

label: ngsTracts CO/NCO/DCO/MOSAIC tract classifications
description: Typed envelope (post-normalize) over per-tract event class + indiv + chrom + start_bp + end_bp + flags. STEP_TRC_01 output bridged via adapter.

label: per-(chrom × dyad) CO/DCO/NCO counts + karyo strat
description: co_count, dco_count, nco_count + co_per_mb, dco_per_mb per (chrom × dyad). Karyo-stratified rows (homA/het/homB) when karyotype_at_focal_inv present.

label: per-(chrom × interval_a × interval_b) coefficient of coincidence
description: c = r_ab / (r_a · r_b). neg_interference_threshold flagging. Both un-stratified (relatedness coincidence page) and karyo-stratified (interchromosomal page) modes.

label: per-(tested chrom × local inversion) covariate matrix
description: Filtered subset of inversion_candidates.v1 used as covariate context for the interchromosomal page; length_bp derived from end-start+1.

label: per-(focal_inv × parent) null-model assignment
description: Joined from family_hubs.v1 + inversion_karyotypes.v1. Provides permutation_block (family_id by default) for shuffle-within-block null.

label: per-candidate sex-specific CO ideogram + telomere curve
description: Per-inversion-candidate JSON: candidate_span, events[chrom,pos,sex,indiv,in_span], telomere_curve. Consumer also includes genome-atlas page3 CO-density sub-track (cross-atlas read).

label: per-candidate NCO/GC tract ideogram + telomere curve
description: Per-inversion-candidate JSON: candidate_span, tracts[chrom,start_bp,end_bp,kind∈nco|gc,indiv,in_span], telomere_curve. Sister to crossover_track.

label: PRDM9 PWM from CO ±2kb hotspots (optional)
description: { pwm: N×4 ACGT PWM | null, tool, evalue, n_hotspots }. Embedded on same per-candidate crossover JSON. Optional — page hides logo card when pwm null.

label: NCO enrichment crosstab + Fisher result per candidate
description: CHAIN OUTPUT. Per-candidate { n_in, n_out, n_in_mosaic_short, n_out_mosaic_short, odds_ratio, p_fisher, p_bh }. Manuscript NCO headline (MOSAIC_SHORT × inside-inv).

label: CO_rate(het) vs CO_rate(non-het) per focal × tested-chrom
description: CHAIN OUTPUT. Per (focal_inversion × tested_chrom): { co_rate_het, co_rate_non_het, rate_ratio, p, flag_lt_0p7 }. Manuscript intrachromosomal-effect signal.

label: HEADLINE: focal inversion karyotype effect on meiosis of OTHER chromosomes
description: CHAIN OUTPUT. Per (focal_inversion × off_focal_chrom): { welch_t, perm_p, p_bh, p_bonf, n_parents_het, n_parents_non_het, local_inv_burden_flag }. Family-aware permutation null (shuffle karyotype labels within permutation_block).

label: Tajima's D per window
description: Per-window Tajima's D from region_popstats.

label: Watterson's theta per window
description: Per-window theta_W from region_popstats.

label: Pooled heterozygosity Hp per window
description: Per-window pooled-sample heterozygosity from region_popstats.

label: Net divergence dA per window
description: Per-window dA = dXY - mean(piA, piB) between two sample sets, from region_popstats.

label: Individual F_HOM
description: Per-sample excess-homozygosity inbreeding-coefficient analog. Rows are (sample, scope_type, scope_id) with PLINK-form FHOM, Hobs-form FHOM_alt, and binned-subsampling diagnostics (bins_used, fraction_of_sites, adaptive_converged).

label: Patterson's D / fdM per window
description: Per-window four-population introgression statistic with block jackknife.

label: iHS per window
description: Per-window aggregated iHS (mean, max|iHS|, n_focal_with_iHS, n_extreme_iHS_abs_gt_2).

label: XP-EHH per window
description: Per-window aggregated XP-EHH (mean, max|XPEHH|, freq-binned normalized variants).

label: pi_N / pi_S per CDS locus
description: Per-CDS-locus pi_N and pi_S with coverage correction and bootstrap CI.

label: pi at 0-fold / 4-fold sites per CDS locus
description: Per-CDS-locus pi at 0-fold and 4-fold degenerate sites with pi_0/pi_4 ratio and bootstrap CI.

label: dN/dS per aligned CDS pair
description: NG86 + YN00 pairwise dN/dS, Ka/Ks, and 4D-site identity per aligned CDS pair.

label: Hobs per arrangement per window
description: Per-arrangement (e.g. homA / het / homB) Hobs and Hexp per sliding window.

label: Rare-SFS sharing (pairwise)
description: Pairwise rare-allele SFS sharing matrix across every pair of sample sets.

label: Outlier regions from genome scan
description: Merged outlier intervals from a statistic-agnostic genome scan (any per-window TSV stat, --direction high | low | abs). Includes per-region rank, mean stat, n_windows.

label: Inside vs flanks Wilcoxon table
description: Per (candidate x stat) Wilcoxon U, permutation p-value, mean inside, mean flank, direction. Validates candidates against local background.

label: Q-residualized genotype dosage matrix
description: Per-sample residual genotype dosage after removing the additive contribution of global Q. Used as input to karyotype clustering and structural-candidate analyses.

label: Per-window Q-support coherence
description: Per-window dominant-Q label + coherence score + switch count + classifier mix. Aggregated from per-SNP soft Q-support vectors. Per chromosome.

label: Per (parent x sample) internal composition class
description: Internal-ancestry structure classification per (parent interval x sample): dominant-label run-lengths, switches, internal entropy, fragmentation, structure class (homogeneous / dominant_plus_secondary / two_block_composite / continuous_gradient / multi_block_fragmented / diffuse_mixed).

label: Inversion-candidate classification (path A / path B / mixed)
description: Per-candidate verdict: ancestry_class (ancestry_driven vs structural vs mixed), coherent_q_loaded_core flag, likely_parasite_windows flag, internal_structure_type. The path-A vs path-B router.

label: Per-subset multi-scale Hobs / HWE windows
description: Per (subset x scale x window) Hobs, Hexp, F, HWE p-value from the ANGSD + hobs_windower pipeline.

label: Hobs / HWE overlay on candidates
description: Per (candidate x subset x scale) inside-vs-flank Hobs / F summaries + outlier burden + distortion pattern (homozygous_excess / heterozygote_excess / mixed).

label: Inversion-boundary candidate intervals
description: (chrom, start, end) intervals where per-window local-ancestry Q composition shifts beyond noise. Output of the boundary scan over an instant_q track. Feeds the candidate classifier and karyotype resolver.

label: Inversion-candidate groupwise popstats
description: Per-(candidate, arrangement) within-group popstats (theta_pi, Hp, FIS) and pairwise between-arrangement popstats (FST, dXY, dA) restricted to the candidate interval. The path-B chain output.

label: Pairwise kinship θ (Jacquard EM)
description: Per-pair θ from ngsRelate Jacquard EM. Column 'theta' of the .res output.

label: KING-robust kinship per pair
description: Per-pair KING-robust kinship. Column 'KING' of the .res output. Source for the adaptive scheduler's per-pair KING-class prior.

label: Jacquard 9-coefficient vector per pair
description: J1–J9 columns of the .res output. Load-bearing for ngsPedigree; untouched by the fork patch.

label: IBS0/IBS1/IBS2 counts per pair
description: Identity-by-state site counts per pair. IBS0 used for parent_offspring vs full_sibling split.

label: Per-sample inbreeding coefficient F
description: Single-individual F from ngsRelate -F mode.

label: Per-chromosome adaptive .res (23-column)
description: Stage-2-compatible per-chromosome .res file produced by the adaptive scheduler. Byte-equivalent column schema to the uniform-stride per-chrom .res; differs only in row-level site budgeting provenance, recorded in the co-emitted adaptive_run_manifest.

label: 6-gate adaptive validation report (JSON)
description: Per-chromosome verdicts for SPEC §6 gates 1–6 against the uniform-stride baseline. Tier-1 (Gates 4, 6) are hard fails; tier-2 (Gate 1) numeric target; tier-3 (Gates 2, 3, 5) informational.

label: Assembly Stats
description: page_scaffold chromosome overview · QC banner (phase B)

label: Chromosome Map
description: karyotype strip · per-chrom navigation (phase B)

label: Gene Track
description: gene cargo per inversion · functional context (phase B/C)

label: Repeat Track
description: TE landscape · breakpoint repeat enrichment (phase B)

label: Te Hierarchy
description: page6 View 4 — TE-hierarchy alluvial (per parental haplotype, N-level)

label: Conserved Elements
description: UCEs · regulatory candidates (phase C/D)

label: Synteny Blocks
description: collinearity vs related Siluriformes · ancestral karyotype (phase D)

label: Macrosynteny Orthologs
description: page9 View 3 — MacrosyntR-style Oxford macro-synteny grid (and linear macro-synteny in later rounds)

label: Centromere Telomere
description: centromere bands · T2T completeness chip (phase B)

label: Variant Annotations
description: deleterious-variant overlap with inversions (phase E)

label: Synteny Oxford Grid
description: page_synteny View 4 — macrosyntR-style Oxford grid (aggregated; one dot per chrom-pair, sized by ortholog count, coloured by BH-q)

label: Ortholog Tables
description: page_orthologues Views 1 + 2 — focal × non-focal summary table and per focal-chrom %1:1 breakdown

label: Ortholog Pairs
description: page_orthologues View 3 — gene-level explorer (one column per non-focal, hydrated on reveal)

label: Staging genome table (v0)
description: Loose staging payload produced by the import_table runner. Carries the raw rows + columns; normalize via a downstream-specific schema once known.

label: Ancestral karyotype reconstruction
description: WGDI ancestral karyotype reconstruction output. Reserved — runner not yet implemented; layer not yet declared in atlases/genome/registries/data/layers.registry.json.

label: Per-sample genome-wide heterozygosity
description: One row per sample: H, n_sites_sfs, sfs_bin0, sfs_bin1.

label: Per-sample folded 1-D SFS
description: Two-bin folded SFS from realSFS -fold 1; { sample_id, bins:[bin0,bin1], folded:true, h }.

label: Cohort-aggregated θπ track
description: Sum of tP and nSites across the per-sample pestPG files re-rendered as a cohort track.

label: Per-sample ROH segments
description: Per-sample table of ROH (runs-of-homozygosity) intervals; chrom, start, end, length, n_sites, quality.

label: Heterozygosity Kruskal-Wallis test by K
description: Omnibus K-W test of H across K ancestry clusters; runtime params K + cohort.

label: Heterozygosity ANOVA by K
description: Parametric ANOVA of H across K ancestry clusters.

label: Pairwise Wilcoxon between K clusters
description: Pairwise post-hoc Wilcoxon matrix across K ancestry-cluster labels.

label: Pairwise t-test between K clusters
description: Pairwise post-hoc t-test matrix across K ancestry-cluster labels.

label: Per-Q × heterozygosity correlations
description: Spearman ρ between each NGSadmix Q-component and per-sample H.

label: Captured diversity-atlas slot envelope
description: Verbatim JSON capture of one /api/diversity/{slot} response wrapped with provenance metadata.

label: Per-sample diversity CHAIN envelope
description: CHAIN output: one envelope per sample composing genomewide_heterozygosity + sfs_folded_1d + theta_pi_windows + roh_per_sample.

label: Ancestry × heterozygosity test-battery envelope
description: CHAIN output: per-(K, cohort) envelope composing the five ancestry-het atomic tests.

label: Per-sample master table
description: D.S1 replacement: per-sample H + F_ROH + K=8 label + ngsF-HMM convergence joined into one row per sample. PLANNED — blocked on roh_per_sample.

label: HPP offspring × variant × haplotype assignment
description: SPEC_HPP.md Table A. One row per (offspring, variant, hap_copy). hap_copy ∈ {hap_from_P1, hap_from_P2, unassigned}; allele_state ∈ {ref, alt, unknown}; projection_source ∈ {parent_homozygous, parent_heterozygous_phased, parent_heterozygous_unphased}; segment_confidence ∈ {Gold, Silver, Bronze}; composite confidence per SPEC §5.

label: HPP per-(offspring, gene, segment) status
description: SPEC_HPP.md Table B. predicted_gene_status ∈ {reference_like, het_masked, hom_exposed_same_variant, compound_het_trans, compound_het_cis, partially_resolved, unresolved}. Headline HPP product for manuscript supplementary; same enum as KBC per-gene status but with per-individual exactness up to inheritance-map confidence.

label: HPP per-(dyad or triad) transmission summary
description: SPEC_HPP.md Tables C and D unified. Per-relationship variant-transmission counts, gene-status counts, Mendelian-consistency status, n_de_novo_candidates (triad-only). No family-hub aggregation.

label: HPP × KBC arrangement-assignment cross-check
description: SPEC_HPP.md Table E. Per (variant, offspring, inversion) concordance between HPP haplotype assignment and KBC karyotype-derived arrangement-background assignment. Discordances at inversion edges / Bronze segments are diagnostic, not failures.

label: BP_ATLAS Pass A PAFs (per pair)
description: Per-pair wfmash PAFs from sensitive Pass A (-s 100k). One file per pair under data/breakpoints/results_bpatlas/02_paf_passA/.

label: BP_ATLAS Pass B PAFs (per pair)
description: Per-pair wfmash PAFs from backbone Pass B (-s 500k). Used for backbone_support flag in zone clustering.

label: BP_ATLAS raw breakpoint events
description: Per-pair raw breakpoint events (NONCOLLINEAR/INVERSION/INTERCHROM). breakpoints_raw.tsv columns: query_chrom, query_pos, event_class, pair_kind.

label: BP_ATLAS clustered zones per anchor
description: Zones from clustering events across pairs. Per-anchor (Cgar + Cmac) tables; confidence tier + backbone_support flag.

label: BP_ATLAS reciprocity (both-anchor zones)
description: Zones supported from Cgar AND Cmac anchors. Strongest evidence tier — supported from both directions.

label: BP_ATLAS atlas data (BP5 figure input)
description: atlas_data.json — figure-input metadata for the BP5 R scripts.

label: BP_ATLAS PAF arcs (BP5 figure input)
description: atlas_paf_arcs.json — arc data for the BP_ATLAS figure layer.

label: BP_ATLAS joint A-E classification (BP6)
description: Manuscript-table-ready 5-class classification (A: cross-method validated bounded inversion; E: karyotype-level fusion / single-method recurrent).

label: Headline consolidated breakpoint clusters
description: Cross-method consolidated table with cross_method flag (gene_order AND wfmash agree within tolerance). Tier 1 (cross-method) vs Tier 2 (recurrent). The manuscript headline catalogue.

label: Per-focal pairwise summary tables
description: Per-focal-frame (Gar / Mac) summary tables. Columns: edge, n_species, species_list.

label: 18-species gene-order breakpoints (≥3sp support)
description: Gene-order edges from BUSCO single-copy orthologs (18-species table). 16 edges in Gar frame, 27-28 in Mac frame. Stability-validated 500kb -> 1kb tolerance sweep.

label: 5-species gene-order breakpoints (denser)
description: Gene-order edges using the denser 5-species ortholog table.

label: Tolerance sweep stability proofs
description: summary_<focal>_<N>kb.tsv files across the 500 -> 1 kb tolerance sweep. Proves stability of cross-method count (not a binning artifact).

label: Per-regime Mendelian annotation
description: Per-regime Method A (trio contradiction) + Method B (per-family chi-sq goodness-of-fit). Columns: regime_id, support_status, family_id, segregation_status, effect_direction, chi2, p_value.

label: Inverse pedigree from regimes
description: Per-sample-pair relatedness verdict from regime co-membership. Columns: sample_a, sample_b, same_class_frac, n_called, by_class, verdict.

label: MSMC2 Ne curve per founder-like group
description: SPEC ONLY. Per-group MSMC2 demographic history. Columns: group, t_generations, ne, ne_lower, ne_upper, mutation_rate, generation_time_y, msmc_version, genome_mask.

label: Per-window K-means labels (Cluster 0)
description: Per-window K-means partition of samples on PC1. Foundation layer for the entire haplotype-regimes pipeline. Atlas-side cache (in-browser).

label: Per-window band-quality score
description: silhouette + size-balance + eig-ratio combined to [0,1]. Gate for seed-discovery anchor selection.

label: Stage 1 V-walker seeds (per chromosome)
description: V-walker anchor + hysteresis output. Each seed: anchor_w, s_window, e_window, K_a, classifications.

label: Het-skeleton intervals (Cluster 1 Path B)
description: HET-band-tracked intervals with bp coords + HOM_A / HOM_B / HET cores per skeleton.

label: Cluster 2 per-target consensus
description: Per-target consensus partition + consensus_class ∈ {CLEAN_PARTITION, SOFT_PARTITION, AMBIGUOUS_BAND, OVERLAPPING_VOTES, MULTI_LAYER_STRUCTURE, NO_CLEAN_CONSENSUS} + resolving_power_class.

label: Refined haplotype regimes
description: Output of refineRegimesFromIntervals — clusters intervals into regimes via union-find on EXTENSION+SWAPPED edges. Per-regime hom_a_intersect / hom_b_intersect / het_union.

label: Cross-regime topology graph
description: Per-chromosome graph of NESTED / ADJACENT / CHAINED / OVERLAPPING_CONFLICT / INDEPENDENT edges + multi-inversion lineage chains.

label: Genome-scale regime aggregation
description: Per-chromosome regimes merged into a flat genome-wide array + cross-chrom CHAINED links.

label: Inversion regime catalogue (cross-page contract)
description: JSON triple emitted by regime_catalogue.serializeCatalogue: manifest.json + knobs.json + catalogue.json. Content-addressed by knob_hash (SHA-1 prefix). The cross-atlas data contract consumed by evolution + popstats atlases.

label: Per-candidate inversion age (3-bracket)
description: Per-candidate age estimate via BUSCO 4D substitutions. 3 brackets (low/mid/high μ).

label: Age-model best-fit suggestion
description: Per-candidate suggested μ model (low/mid/high) based on dxy + private-variant pattern.

label: Per-candidate polarity verdict
description: Polarity verdict: which haplotype class is HOM_REF vs HOM_INV. Output of polarize_synteny_vote OR polarize_msa_stacked (different methods, same verdict layer).

label: Sub-PCA on derived-only samples
description: Sub-structure within the INV class — haplotype clusters / nested rearrangements / sublineages.

label: Per-candidate haplotype network
description: Minimum-spanning haplotype network of INV chromosomes.

label: Per-window mosaicism leakage
description: Per-sample per-window mosaic-call + summary leakage score.

label: Kinship-downweighted ancestry layers
description: Cleaned ancestry weights — close relatives + hatchery duplicates downweighted.

label: Per-chromosome event-tree (relative ordering)
description: Relative ordering of inversion events on the same chromosome.

label: Per-candidate archaeology synthesis card
description: Step-6 verdict — polarity + age + integrity + mosaicism + frequency + π/dXY/FST + private/fixed + confidence.

label: Copy-origin painting (SPEC)
description: SPEC ONLY. Refines polarity verdicts when implemented.

label: Gene-conversion tracts (NCO classifications)
description: Per-tract NCO / gene-conversion classifications produced by ngsTracts STEP_TRC_01 (classify_intervals). Class enum: NCO (short, anywhere), MOSAIC_SHORT (50-200 kb inside inversions), MOSAIC_LONG (long-span suspicious tracts with matching flanks). Backs gene_conversion_tracts.v1.
intended_use: inside-vs-outside-inversion NCO enrichment; meiotic gene-conversion rate

label: Cross-species × 226-cohort haploblock overlap
description: Per (cross_species_atlas breakpoint_cluster × inversion_atlas long_range_haplotype_regime) intersection on the fClaHyb_Gar_LG frame. One row per overlap_id with cluster_id, haploblock_id, span_overlap_bp, fraction_overlap, evidence_tier ∈ {cross_method_validated, recurrent}. Coordinate-only — never importing comparative-cohort claims about hatchery samples.
intended_use: bridge between cross_species coordinates and inversion_atlas candidate review
